data_fields.name: answerTimeout
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (no timeout found in goal.cpp, goal_gui.cpp, script_goal.cpp); proposed field

best_idea: Model a dialogue as a parked record keyed by an id: the server stores the addressee and the offered choices, accepts one answer from the addressee, and resumes the quest script with one event.
decision_why: The id-keyed parked question with one answer event is the right shape for server-decided quest dialogue, but the donor has no pending, addressee, once or close checks, so Frankendom adds them on the server and keeps the window client-only.
acceptance: Server test: an Accept/Decline offer addressed to player A rejects B's answer; A's Accept emits one event and pays the reward once; a second Accept is rejected; closing the box emits one cancel event and no reward; a two-choice and a three-choice offer both render at 375 wide without overlap.
